name: MonarchAiAgentAvatar
title: AiAgentAvatar
wrapsNative: MonarchAvatar (square shape) in an androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box with Modifier.drawBehind drawing the state ring (DrawScope.drawRoundRect with a SweepGradientShader turned by rememberInfiniteTransition, or PathEffect.dashPathEffect), and a CircleShape badge
summary: The picture of an AI agent: a rounded square with an AI badge, so it is never taken for a person's round avatar, and a ring that shows whether the agent is working, waiting for someone or stopped with an error.
whenToUse: Wherever an agent appears as an actor: beside its messages, in a list of agents, on a task it owns.
whenNotToUse: Not for people, workspaces or apps (use MonarchAvatar). Not to show that a single answer is AI-generated (use MonarchAiGeneratedBadge).
api: @Composable public fun MonarchAiAgentAvatar(agent: MonarchAiAgentRef, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, image: Painter? = null, state: MonarchAiAgentState = MonarchAiAgentState.Idle, size: MonarchAvatarSize = MonarchAvatarSize.Md, showState: Boolean = false, decorative: Boolean = false, badgeIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiAgentAvatarLabels = MonarchAiAgentAvatarLabels())
public enum class MonarchAiAgentState { Idle, Working, Waiting, Error }
public class MonarchAiAgentAvatarLabels(kind: String? = null, state: ((MonarchAiAgentState) -> String)? = null)

options.name: agent
options.description: The agent from the conversation model: name names the avatar, codename feeds the initials, id picks the fallback color. avatar is a URL that the app loads itself and passes as image.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the avatar and its state text.

options.name: image
options.description: The agent's picture, loaded by the app. null shows the initials.

options.name: state
options.description: What the agent is doing: idle, working, waiting (needs a person) or error.

options.name: size
options.description: 24, 32 or 40dp before the font scale, as MonarchAvatar.

options.name: showState
options.description: Writes the state beside the picture.

options.name: decorative
options.description: Hides the avatar from TalkBack when the agent's name is written beside it; a state other than idle is still read.

options.name: badgeIcon
options.description: An icon inside the badge, for example a bot glyph, given the badge's content color. Monarch bundles no icons; without it the badge is a filled mark.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the kind ("AI agent") and the state names.

states.name: working
states.description: A ring in the AI strong and AI subtle colors that turns once every 1.6 seconds; a still AI strong ring when animations are off.

states.name: waiting
states.description: A dashed ring in the warning strong color.

states.name: error
states.description: A ring in the danger strong color and a danger solid badge.

states.name: no picture
states.description: Initials of the codename, else the name, on a color picked from the agent id; the color alone when there are no letters or digits.

appearance: A rounded square picture with a small round badge at the bottom end corner, filled with the AI solid color (danger solid on error) and ringed with the surface color. Rings use the AI, warning and danger strong roles. All colors are theme roles, so dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: Same states and labels as iOS. Sizes are MonarchAvatar's three sizes; the web's xs, xl and numeric sizes are not offered. The web draws a bot glyph and iOS an SF Symbol; Monarch for Android bundles no icons, so the badge is a filled mark and the app may pass badgeIcon. Following the Android image convention the picture is a Painter the app loads (iOS loads agent.avatar with AsyncImage), so there is one composable instead of iOS's two initialisers. The web's moving ring is a turning sweep gradient here too, and stands still when animations are removed.
accessibility: The avatar is one TalkBack element with the image role, read as "Research agent, AI agent", plus the state when it is not idle, such as ", Working", which is also its state description.
The state is always in words, so it never depends on the ring's color, dash or motion.
With decorative the avatar is hidden, except that a state other than idle is read on its own.
The visible state text is not read a second time.
When animations are removed the working ring stands still.
The picture and the badge grow with the font scale.
edgeCases: A name of emoji or symbols only shows the fallback color without initials.
A blank codename falls back to the name; a missing id picks the color from the name.
A long state text wraps beside the picture.
